acceptance.sketch: Apply a diameter constraint to a circle and assert a variable named dia1 appears in the Parameters Manager; rename it to Hole and convert it to reference and assert it no longer drives the circle.

notes: Added from help page "About Applying Dimensional Constraints"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must let users show or hide dynamic constraints (via DCDISPLAY or the ribbon, temporarily revealed on selecting their object) and control annotational constraints through layers and dimension-style properties.

source.ref: About Controlling the Display of Dimensional Constraints

acceptance.sketch: Hide dynamic constraints, select a constrained object and assert its dynamic constraints reappear temporarily; freeze the annotational constraint layer and assert they disappear.

notes: Added from help page "About Controlling the Display of Dimensional Constraints"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must let users change geometry by editing dimensional constraint names, values or expressions (in-place, TEXTEDIT, Properties palette, Parameters Manager or Quick Properties), by grips, or by editing user variables, and allow expressions to reference other constraints.

source.ref: About Modifying Objects With Dimensional Constraints Applied

acceptance.sketch: Double-click constraint d1 on a 6-unit line, enter 9 and assert the line is 9 long; enter an expression referencing d2 and assert it follows d2.

notes: Added from help page "About Modifying Objects With Dimensional Constraints Applied"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must support formulas as expressions in dimensional constraint parameters and in user variables (functions such as square root, parentheses, operator precedence, PI, references to other parameters), all visible in the Parameters Manager.

acceptance.sketch: Set Length=10 and Width=4, define user variable Area=Length*Width and a circle Radius=sqrt(Area/PI) and assert the radius evaluates to about 3.568; change Width and assert it updates.

notes: Added from help page "About Parametric Formulas and Equations"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: Dino 8 must let users create parameter groups in the Parameters Manager per space, assign parameters to groups by drag and drop as a display filter, and provide the fixed All and All Used in Expressions filters.

source.ref: About Organizing Parameters Into Parameter Groups

acceptance.sketch: Create group Frame, drag parameter d1 into it, select the group and assert only d1 is listed; select All Used in Expressions and assert only referenced parameters appear.

notes: Added from help page "About Organizing Parameters Into Parameter Groups"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.
